questions.statement: Which verb tense is mainly used throughout the second paragraph, and why is it used?

options.text: Simple present, because it describes facts about the island — things that will probably not change in the near future.
Present perfect, because the present facts described are consequences of actions that happened in the past.
Simple past, because the past events have a clear time reference.
Simple present, because the events described are not permanent, but temporary.
Present perfect, because the stated events do not have a past time reference.

questions.explanation: O simple present descreve fatos, características e estados habituais ou relativamente estáveis da ilha. O present perfect liga passado e presente, enquanto o simple past situa fatos concluídos; não se trata de acontecimentos apenas temporários.
